2. Role Overview:- 
➔​ Role Overview 
This Portal has multiple users of different roles for each station. Each role has 
specific jobs to perform. These roles are: 
1. Station Admin. 
2. Secretary Executive. 
3. Program Executive 
4. Signing Authority/H.O.P. 
5. Account officer. 
6. Artist. 
Each Station must have Station Admin credentials to start Artist/Talent Booking 
Software (ABS/TBS). For Station Admin Credentials, the following details are to 
be sent to the email address “support@prasarbharati.gov.in” with ‘ABS’ in the 
subject line: 
1. Station Name 
2. Station Address 
3. Head of Program Name 
4. Head of Program Email ID 
5. Head of Program Mobile No. 

4

Once Station receives its Admin credentials. The station can start using the Artist/Talent 
Booking Software Portal. 
1) ADMIN ROLE: Station Admin will have the default as Section/Unit. 
Admin Dashboard has various functions given below: 
1. Artist at Station 
2. All Channels 
3. All Sections/Units 
4. Manage Secretary/TREX 
5. Manage Executive 
6. Manage Signature Authority 
7. Manage Duty Officer/Extra Staff 
8. Manage Account Officer 
9. Manage H.O.P. 
10. Manage Staff Account 
11. All Artists 
12. All Bookings 
13. Add Artist Expertise 
14. Approve Artists 
15. Artist ledger 
16. Allow Back Date 
17. Change Password 

●​ Steps to Login: 

5

●​ The Station Admin Dashboard functions: 
1. Artist at Station: All the artists registered in the station are listed. 

2. All Channels: All the running channels on their Station need to be created here. 
Details of registered channels can be Create/Edit/Delete/Activate/Deactivate in this tab. 
To create a channel, click on ADD Channel. 

8

3. All Sections/Units: All the working Sections/Units at their Station need to be created 
here. Details of registered Sections/Units can be Create/Edit/Delete/Deactivate in this 
tab. 
To create a Section/Unit click on ADD Section/Unit. While Creating Sections, their 
respective channels also need to be selected (Press Ctrl for multiple channels, showing 
in the list of Available Channels). In case a new registered Channel is not available in 
the list, please refresh the Page. 

9

4. Manage Secretary/TREX: All the Program Executives in their Station need to be 
registered here. Details of the registered Program Executive can be 
Create/Edit/Delete/Activate/Deactivate in this tab. A unique Email ID is required to 
register a new User. 
To create a Program Executive, click on ADD EXECUTIVE. While creating Program 
Executive, their respective Section/Unit also needs to be selected (Press Ctrl for 
multiple Section/Unit, showing in the list of Available Section/Unit). After successful 
submission of the registration form, the user's Username and Password will be 
automatically generated, which can be passed to the user. 

10

5. Manage Program Executives: All the Program Executives in their Station need to 
register here. Details of the registered Program Executive can be 
Create/Edit/Delete/Activate/Deactivate in this tab. A unique email ID is required to 
register a new User. 
To create a Program Executive, click on ADD EXECUTIVE. While creating an 
Executive, their respective Section/Unit also needs to be selected (Press Ctrl for 
multiple Section/Unit, showing in the list of Available Section/Unit). After successful 
submission of the registration form, the user's Username and Password will be 
automatically generated, which can be passed to the user. 

11

6. Manage Signature Authority: All the Signature Authorities in their Station need to 
be registered here. Details of the registered Authority can be Create/Edit/Delete 
Activate/Deactivate in this tab. A unique email ID is required to register a new User. 
To create a Signature Authority, click on ADD SIGNATURE AUTHORITY. While 
creating Signature Authority, their respective Section/Unit also needs to be selected 
(Press Ctrl for multiple Section/Unit, showing in the list of Available Section/unit). In 
case a new registered Section/Unit is not available in the list, Please Refresh the Page. 
After successful submission of the registration form, the user's Username and Password 
will be automatically generated, which can be passed to the user. 

12

7. Manage Duty Officer/Extra Staff: All the Duty Officers/Extra Staff in their Station 
need to be registered here. Details of the registered Officer can be Create/Edit/Delete 
Activate/Deactivate in this tab. A unique email ID is required to register a new User. 

13

Assign the Voucher generation role to Extra staff/TREX: 
●​ Login with Admin & click on Manage Duty Officer/Extra Staff and add the staff 
name with the mail id. 

15

●​ We can also assign voucher generation roles to existing staff, like PEX etc. 

16

8. Manage Account Officer: All the Account Officers in their Station need to be 
registered here. Details of the registered Officers can be Create/Edit/Delete 
Activate/Deactivate in this tab. A unique email ID is required to register a new User. 

17

9. Manage H.O.P.: All the Heads of the Program in their stations need to be registered 
here. Details of the registered Officers can be Create/Edit/Delete Activate/Deactivate in 
this tab. A unique email ID is required to register a new User. 

18

10. Manage Staff Account: Through the Manage Staff Account tab, the station can 
reset the password of its station staff, deactivate the user and also delete their 
registration. 

●​ The forgot password option has been given in the user's login. Kindly ensure that 
the registered mobile number is correct. The otp is also sent to the registered 
mail id. Kindly check the Inbox/Notification/Spam folders. 

20

●​ In case of transfer or retirement, the user can be deactivated, and the same 
email id can be used at new stations. 

21

●​ The Secretary Executive Dashboard functions: 
1. Artists at Station: To register an Artist, click on ADD ARTIST, fill in the details of the 
Artist and Submit. Artist Expertise also needs to be mapped while registering the Artist. 
By clicking on FETCH EXPERTISE (for multiple Expertise of Artist, multiple selections 
can be made in the list by the press and hold ctrl key). 
32

2. Get Artist ID: The Artist ABS ID can be checked here by entering the artist’s PAN. 

33

3. All Artists: Artist page will show the list of artists registered country-wide. Details of 
the artist can be seen by clicking on the artist row. 

34

4. Artist’s Booking Details: The Artist's booking details can be checked here by 
entering the artist's ABS id and the month. 

35

5. Book Artist: 
Manage Booking: 
a) Click on Book Artist. 
b) Select the Main Category (Number of bookings for Resource Person-1 per 
month and for Assignee-6 per month) 
c) Select the Expertise. 
d) Select Sub Category. 
e) Select the Grade Type. 
f) List of Available Artists according to the above selection will come to the screen 
g) Select the Artist as per the requirement. 
h) Fill in the payment details(grade fee according to selection will come 
automatically), other allowances can be fill in the form. 
i) Details related to the Booking need to be entered in next tab. 
j) Submit the booking. 

36

5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) for Station Admin/ 
Secretary Executive/ Program Executive/ Signing Authority/ 
Account Officer:- 
Que 1. How can I log in to the ABS Portal? 
Ans: 
●​ Use your Login Credentials to log in at https://abs.prasarbharati.org/​

●​ Authentication uses OTP sent to your registered mobile and email (2FA enabled) 
Que 2. How to update or allow the backdate? 
Ans: Follow the steps below to proceed successfully: 
1. Log in with the Station Admin Role. 
2. Click on the "Allow Back Date" module. 
3. In the Allow till field, select tomorrow's date and time 
4. Enter the description/remarks and submit. Log out of the Admin role. 
5. Now, log in with the Pex/SecEx role, go to the Book Artist Module, and select the 
back date (Back date will be visible here after you have followed the above steps 
properly). 

93

Que 3. I am not getting the login OTP at my email ID and mobile number. 
Ans: Email request to support@prasarbharati.gov.in with ‘ABS’ in the subject line from 
your registered email ID. 

Que 4. OTP not received. How to update the Registered Mobile number? 
Ans: Contact your station admin for the profile update. 

Que 5. How to add expertise to the Artists? 
Ans: Contact your station admin for the profile update. 
94

Que 6. Email ID Pex login not showing the 'Generate Telecast / Broadcast 
Certificate' option for assignees and artists. How to assign duty? 
Ans: 
Kindly follow the steps below: 
1. Login with your station admin account. 
2. Select Module "Manage Duty Officer/ Extra Staff". 
3. Click on "Assign Role to Existing Officer". 
4. "Assign Duty" to each newly created PEX(s). 

This will enable the "Generate Telecast / Broadcast Certificate" module for the Pex's 
email id login.

6. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) for Artist:- 
Que 1. How can I log in to the ABS Portal? 
Ans: Kindly follow the steps below to Login at https://abs.prasarbharati.org/ : 
1. Enter your registered Email id. 
2. Click on "Fetch Section/Unit". It will show default Section/Unit. 
3. Enter Password. 
4. Enter Captcha. 
5. Click on "Login" to proceed. 

Que 2. I am unable to log in to the ABS portal as I forgot my password. How can I 
reset my password? 
Ans: Kindly use the "Forgot Password" option to reset your password. 

Que 3. How to accept/reject a new contract?
